subject: Next steps: Technical deep dive (Medlytics / Redwood)
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila.reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@medlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: Technical deep dive (Medlytics / Redwood)

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our discovery so we can align on next steps:

- Primary goal: reduce inference latency for core clinical scoring models while cutting cost per prediction; explore hybrid hosted + private options for PHI-containing workloads.
- Key constraints: existing Kyverno policies, SOC 2 requirement for audit logs, and PCI-like retention windows for exported artifacts.
- Current infra: cluster of NVIDIA A10s in GCP, model serving via TensorFlow/TF-Serving and some custom C++ components.

Per our ask, the next step would be a 60–90 minute technical deep dive with your ML + infra teams to:
1) walkthrough current inference pipeline and pain points,
2) run through Redwood's serving runtime and private deployment options (VPC / on-prem),
3) discuss performance benchmarks, quantization/compatibility, and any PII handling,
4) surface integration work and rollout plan.

Proposed times (PT) next week:
- Tue 2026-06-23: 9:00–10:30 or 13:00–14:30
- Wed 2026-06-24: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your side will attend (ML lead, infra/ops, security/compliance contact)? I’ve cc'd Marissa (solutions) and Ethan (infra lead) who will join from our side.

Attached is a short agenda draft — happy to iterate based on your priorities.

Best,

Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_technical-deep-dive-agenda.pdf (application/pdf)

Camila —

Thanks for the recap and for the proposed agenda — this looks good. We’re definitely interested in moving forward with a technical deep dive. Wed 2026-06-24 10:00–11:30 PT works best for our team.

Attendees from our side:
- Alex Chen — Head of ML (me)
- Samira Rahman — Infra/Ops (cc'd)
- Robert Li — CTO (may join for the first 20–30 mins)

Priority topics for us: deeper discussion of private deployment options (VPC and on-prem), data retention/audit log capabilities, and migration plan for models with large KV cache state. Please include any pre-read we should review.

We’ll accept a calendar invite for Wed 6/24 10:00 PT. Could you also invite Ethan (your infra lead) and Marissa?

Thanks Alex — Wed 6/24 10:00–11:30 PT is locked. I’ll send the calendar invite now.

Ethan — can you please lead the infra/private deployment portion and be prepared to cover:
- Redwood Private options (VPC vs on-prem) — architecture and network requirements (10–15 min)
- Audit logging / KMS integration / SOC 2 evidence (10 min)
- Model compatibility and quantization recommendations for A10s (15 min)
- Performance profiling approach and what we’d need from Medlytics (sample payloads, sequence length distribution, perf targets) (15–20 min)

Proposed 80-minute agenda (will share as a doc and attach to calendar invite):
- 10 min — quick intros & goals alignment
- 20 min — Medlytics current pipeline walkthrough (Alex / Samira)
- 25 min — Redwood runtime & private deployment deep dive (Ethan + Marissa)
- 15 min — integration/discovery checklist and next steps (open discussion)
- 10 min — Q&A / follow-ups / action items
